title: These don’t nest
text: These don’t nest. As cute as these are, they are not practical because I can’t keep them tucked neatly into my kitchen drawer.  The wood is a little on the coarse side. And a little clunky to hold. I doubt I’d order these again but dang it! They are cute.

product_metadata.title: GuDoQi Measuring Cups and Spoons Set of 8, Wood Handle with Metric and US Measurements, Premium Stainless Steel, Golden Polished Finish, Dry & Liquid Measuring Cup for Cooking and Baking
features: Easy to clean: Stainless steel measuring spoon is made from non stick materials to ensure that even the most stubborn ingredients can be washed off easily, whether they be wet or dry contents. As the handle is made of wooden, we suggest you hand wash only, and wipe off the water after cleaning.
